articles.summary: Fluor Corporation (NYSE: FLR) announced today that James F. (Frank) Caldwell Jr., retired U.S. Navy Admiral, has been elected to its Board of Directors effective August 4, 2026. Caldwell’s appointment brings the total number of Fluor Board members to 11, of whom 10 are independent. He will serve on the Board's Audit and Governance Committees. Fluor appoints James F. (Frank) Caldwell Jr., retired U.S. Navy Admiral, to its Board of Directors "Frank Caldwell's unparalleled experience leading the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program and managing one of the nation's most technically sophisticated enterprises brings valuable insight to Fluor," said James T. Hackett, Chairman of the Fluor Board. "His expertise in nuclear operations and safety, strategic planning, governance, risk management and government affairs, combined with decades of leadership in complex mission-critical environments, will support Fluor's continued growth across nuclear energy, government and defense markets." Caldwell
articles.title: Fluor Announces Appointment of James F. (Frank) Caldwell Jr. to Its Board of Directors
